import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

n = int(data[0])
z = int(data[1])
x = list(map(int, data[2:n+2]))

x.sort()

left = 0
right = n // 2
max_pairs = 0

while right < n:
    if x[right] - x[left] >= z:
        max_pairs += 1
        left += 1
    right += 1

print(max_pairs)
